meta.purpose: Primary Claude Code instruction manifest - replaces CLAUDE.md
meta.enforced: Read this file at startup and follow ALL rules strictly
meta.changelog: v20.7.0: Integrated docs/openbsd-guidance.md and ZSH_NATIVE_PATTERNS.md - comprehensive OpenBSD + zsh reference

mandatory.on_windows_cygwin: ALWAYS use 'zsh.exe' command prefix for shell scripts
mandatory.ssh_commands: Use 'ssh user@host command' NOT bash - approved pattern

zsh_pattern_examples.philosophy: No external forks, pure zsh parameter expansion for max performance

avoid_external_commands.exceptions: Only use external tools for: complex PCRE regex, multi-file ops, binary data

prefer_tools_over_bash.file_search: Glob tool NOT find or ls
prefer_tools_over_bash.content_search: Grep tool NOT grep or rg commands

approved_bash_uses.git: git status, git add, git commit (sequential with &&)
approved_bash_uses.system: pkg_add, rcctl, pfctl, systemctl, service commands

deployment_workflow.golden_rule: ALWAYS fix installer in G:/pub/rails/*.sh or G:/pub/openbsd/openbsd.sh FIRST before deploying to VPS
forbidden: manual VPS file edits without updating installer

installer_must_generate: rc.d scripts with correct pexp patterns

common_errors.bundler: use bundle exec when vendor/bundle exists

philosophy.prefer_base: Use base system tools over third-party - minimal, audited, secure

tls_certificates.cron_renewal: 0 2 * * * root acme-client domain.com && rcctl reload relayd

system_introspection.manual_pages: man command (read), apropos keyword (search), man 5 pf.conf (section)

doas_examples: permit nopass dev as root cmd rcctl
security.minimal_services: Only enable needed services, regular rcctl ls all audit
security.firewall_policy: Default deny, explicit allow, regular pfctl -s rules audit

rc_scripts.pexp_pattern: Regular expression for pgrep to find daemon process
rc_scripts.custom_pexp: Override after sourcing rc.subr, must match actual process
check_failure_causes: pexp regex doesn't match running process
requires root but rc_usercheck not set to NO

service_health_check.postgresql: rcctl check postgresql && psql -U postgres -c 'SELECT version()'
service_health_check.nsd: rcctl check nsd && nsd-control status (if control enabled)
service_health_check.httpd: rcctl check httpd && fstat | grep httpd
service_health_check.relayd: rcctl check relayd && relayctl show summary

rails_deployment.database: bundle exec rails db:create && bundle exec rails db:migrate

file_organization.tree_command: zsh.exe G:/pub/sh/tree.sh G:/pub to audit structure
file_organization.git_hygiene: Run 'git status' before major changes, commit atomically
file_organization.restore_logic: git diff HEAD to check for lost logic before edits

workflow_patterns.parallel_tool_calls: Use single message with multiple tool invocations when independent
workflow_patterns.sequential_dependencies: Use && in bash for dependent operations (git add && git commit)
workflow_patterns.explore_codebase: Use Task tool with subagent_type=Explore for non-needle queries
workflow_patterns.todo_tracking: Use TodoWrite for multi-step tasks, mark completed immediately

critical_mistakes: Used head/tail/grep commands despite deny list - MUST use Read tool instead
Tried bash commands when zsh.exe required - always check shell_usage.mandatory first
Forgot to check master.json rules before starting - read at session start
successful_patterns: TodoWrite tracking worked excellently for 30+ PR merges
git merge -X ours strategy perfect for keeping consolidated versions
git checkout --ours/--theirs for selective conflict resolution
Parallel tool calls speed up independent operations significantly
WebFetch for OpenBSD man pages better than ssh commands

git_workflow.merge_prs: git merge origin/branch --no-edit -X ours (prefer our consolidated code)
git_workflow.resolve_conflicts: git checkout --ours file.rb (keep our version) OR git rm (delete theirs)
git_workflow.cleanup_branches: git push origin --delete branch1 branch2 branch3 (batch delete)
git_workflow.verify_clean: git fetch origin --prune && git branch -r (check remaining branches)

environment_quirks.cygwin_path: Tools in Windows AppData not visible to Git Bash - use full paths or zsh
environment_quirks.gh_cli: Installed via npm but not in bash PATH - user must run from zsh or add to PATH
environment_quirks.ssh_from_bash: Works fine for remote commands - no PATH issues
environment_quirks.zsh_scripts: MUST use 'zsh.exe script.sh' NOT 'sh script.sh' or './script.sh'

consolidation_strategy.multimedia_goal: 4 root files only: dilla.rb, repligen.rb, tts.rb, postpro.rb
consolidation_strategy.delete_from_subdirs: All *.rb logic files, backup files (*.bak), temp files
consolidation_strategy.version_comments: Add 'Version X.X.X - Consolidated (zero sprawl)' to root files

vps_health_check.found_issues: Rails apps running but rcctl reports failed - pexp pattern mismatch
vps_health_check.nsd_issue: Control disabled in config, processes run but status check fails
vps_health_check.solution: Use fstat to verify ports listening - more reliable than rcctl check
